messages:
sre_bot: ALERT: Streaming endpoint latency breach in eu-central-1. p95 jumped to 600ms, p99 ~3.1s. Auto-page to oncall.
oncall_eli: on it. I see correlated increase in blkio wait and cgroup throttling on pool 'shared-gpu-eu-3'.
infra_sam: pulling host snapshots now. preliminary: host gpu-node-77 shows sustained write throughput from cgroup tenant=tn-77x and high dirty page writeback.
runtime_zoe: that could cause KV cache eviction + reloads causing streaming stalls. Any recent deploys to that pool?
ops_han: no deploys in last 30m. scheduler shows a flurry of batch jobs for tn-77x starting ~6632109600.
product_ari: CS reports multiple customers with streaming frames gaps and reconnects — they called it "stutter". marking potential customer-impact.
cs_maria: affected accounts reported: ACC-4403, ACC-2219. initial customer messages aggregated in ticket CRT-7782.
infra_sam: dropping a quick snippet of host counters:
```
# gpu-node-77
blkio.io_serviced: tn-77x write=1.2g tn-9a read=8m
memory.dirty: tn-77x=520M
cpu.stat tn-77x: nr_periods=150 nr_throttled=149
```
oncall_eli: heavy write throttling. two-prong immediate plan: 1) move tn-77x off shared-gpu-eu-3 (evict) 2) apply runtime soft-fallback for streaming KV reads to avoid write-heavy paths.
runtime_zoe: I can flip a feature flag to disable async writeback for that tenant: KVBYPASS_WRITEBACK=true. That should reduce IO quickly but may increase memory usage.
ops_han: eviction API ready. recommended: evict -> isolate -> spin up dedicated small instances for high-priority customers to avoid service interruption.
deploy-bot: Eviction job queued by ops_han.
infra_sam: starting eviction trace now. scheduler logs show migrations begin at 6632109755.
cs_maria: notifying ACC-4403 with a short status: "we're mitigating a service degradation and will update within 20 minutes".
oncall_eli: applying runtime flag now.
runtime_zoe: KVBYPASS_WRITEBACK applied for tn-77x. Observing immediate drop in writeback bytes.
infra_sam: host metrics post-actions:
```
time=6632109830 node=gpu-node-77 blkio_util=48% p95_stream=240ms p99_stream=520ms
```
oncall_eli: good drop. p99 still elevated but trending down. continue to monitor for 30m.
product_ari: do we have a list of impacted routes? want to check alerting coverage.
runtime_zoe: affected routes: /v1/stream/transcribe, /v1/stream/translate. adding temporary route-level throttles for lower-tier to reduce load.
ops_han: migration complete: tn-77x workload moved to isolated-burst queue and 3 dedicated pods started for high-priority tenants.
cs_maria: customers updated. ACC-2219 acknowledged and asked for RCA once available.
oncall_eli: logging mitigation steps to incident timeline. current status: mitigated, monitoring.
sre_bot: UPDATE: mitigation in place (eviction + KVBYPASS). Status: monitoring. Severity: Sev2. start=6632109600 mitigated=6632109835.
infra_sam: follow-ups to create:
- P0: implement automatic noisy-tenant detector (blkio spike alert + auto-isolate)
- P1: expose per-cgroup blkio metrics in Console with route mapping
- P1: add runbook entry for KVBYPASS toggle and eviction workflow
runtime_zoe: long-term: partition write-heavy tenants to write-optimized pools, enforce blkio quotas at scheduling time, and surface writeback rate per-tenant in Console.
product_ari: will coordinate customer comms template and credit policy with CS.
cs_maria: posting interim outbound now; will send detailed follow-up after postmortem.
oncall_eli: handing off to infra_sam and runtime_zoe for postmortem. I will remain available for 1hr.
deploy-bot: Reminder: suppress repeat alerts for this signal for 45m.
infra_sam: collecting artifacts: blkio counters, host perf graphs, eviction traces, tenant job manifests.
runtime_zoe: collecting streaming traces and sample request IDs for stalled sessions.
product_ari: scheduling retro with SRE/Runtime/Platform tomorrow 10:00 UTC.
cs_maria: adding impacted accounts to customer-impact tracker CRT-7782.
oncall_eli: closing active-page. leave channel for follow-ups. :white_check_mark:"
